name: Agenheim
slug: A cold -heim stop where the party landed and bought heat stones from Nyx Cage on the way to Jotunheim.
description: Agenheim is one of the -heim stops on the way toward Jotunheim. It was cold when the party landed there, and Nyx Cage the Ice Mage sold them heat stones.

log.summary: The party remembers Agenheim as the -heim where they landed and bought heat stones from Nyx Cage the Ice Mage because it was cold, before continuing toward Jotunheim.
notes: Where the party landed and bought heat stones from Nyx Cage the Ice Mage, because it was cold, before continuing toward Jotunheim. Remembered as one of the -heim stops on that journey.
